title: Editor startup crash when opening project with nested project
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 beta7 and likely earlier

### System information

W10

### Issue description

When you have a nested `project.godot` and your project has a custom theme defined, it will crash:
```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.beta.custom_build (6c9aa4c7d3b9b91cd50714c40eeb234874df7075)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[0] EditorFileSystem::_should_skip_directory (C:\godot_source\editor\file_system\editor_file_system.cpp:3445)
[1] EditorFileSystem::_scan_new_dir (C:\godot_source\editor\file_system\editor_file_system.cpp:1155)
[2] EditorFileSystem::_load_first_scan_root_dir (C:\godot_source\editor\file_system\editor_file_system.cpp:248)
[3] EditorFileSystem::scan_for_uid (C:\godot_source\editor\file_system\editor_file_system.cpp:256)
[4] ResourceUID::get_id_path (C:\godot_source\core\io\resource_uid.cpp:195)
[5] ResourceLoader::_validate_local_path (C:\godot_source\core\io\resource_loader.cpp:508)
[6] ResourceLoader::_load_start (C:\godot_source\core\io\resource_loader.cpp:568)
[7] ResourceLoader::load (C:\godot_source\core\io\resource_loader.cpp:555)
[8] ThemeDB::initialize_theme (C:\godot_source\scene\theme\theme_db.cpp:65)
[9] Main::setup2 (C:\godot_source\main\main.cpp:3721)
[10] Main::setup (C:\godot_source\main\main.cpp:2838)
[11] widechar_main (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:81)

[13] main (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:136)
[14] WinMain (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:150)
[15] __scrt_common_main_seh (D:\a\_work\1\s\src\vctools\crt\vcstartup\src\startup\exe_common.inl:288)
[16] ShimMainCRTStartup (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\cpu_feature_validation.c:74)
[17] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
```
It only happens when there is no filesystem cache (usually when `.godot` is missing). Trying to use Recovery Mode does not help.

### Steps to reproduce

Just try to open the MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[motherofcornercrashes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22127268/motherofcornercrashes.zip)
